newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures remain lower as trade quiets.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures remain lower as trade quiets.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. debt futures remained slightly lower as trade quieted down from early choppiness. Traders watching U.S. budget progress, said hopes for quick deal waning. One Euro broker said selling could materialize later if budget hopes wane further. Some profit-taking noted. June T-bond support at 109-00.
